task.description: WF-01 micro-amendment of the released-to-be requirement REQ-113 (status in_progress; nothing of it is on main). The owner decided on 2026-11-22: the look is «Похоже» (G21 for the look passes), and his answer «да» to three wording questions: (F1) spell out ТЗ; (F2) say plainly that there is no way to get an invitation yet; (F3) keep the stage name «Принято» (the name, and so also its note how_stage_1_note, is NOT changed). Make exactly these wording changes in the REQ-113 block and nothing else. (A) ru now_idea_s becomes «ИИ-аналитик задаёт вопросы и пишет техническое задание (ТЗ).» (the title now_idea_t «Опрос по вашей идее и ТЗ» stays in ru; the short form stands in the title and is spelled out in the line right under it); en now_idea_s stays. (B) ru now_closing becomes «Даты запуска пока нет. Описать идею смогут только приглашённые участники. Способа получить приглашение пока нет. Готовый продукт посетителям пока не выдаётся.»; en becomes «No launch date is set yet. Only invited participants will be able to describe an idea. There is no way to get an invitation yet. Finished products are not handed out to visitors yet.» (no contact, form or waiting list is promised: none exists; check that the sentence breaks no other sentence of the block, for example the 'not covered' list and the five facts: the block then says six facts or the five plus one; state it truthfully). (C) The four en values agreed by two independent translation readers (finding W1 of step-08d): idea_panel_lead «You cannot describe an idea in Sai yet: the button opens tips on how to describe it.»; now_idea_t «Survey on your idea and the requirements»; stat_on «Working»; demo_accuracy_note «The more answers, the more reliable the hint. “Not sure” counts as half.» (ru of these four stays). Because the en stat_on changes, also check every place that says en «Works» (description, criteria, mutants, tests named in the block) and change it to «Working»; keep en stat_off «Not yet». (D) kk: the kk values of now_idea_s and now_closing are drafts written by the coding role in the pattern of the neighbours; the requirement says that these two drafts follow the new ru, nothing more, and that the kk doubts of the readers stay with ISS-0127 (FOR_NATIVE_SPEAKER). (E) The requirement must say that after the code round the two changed groups are read again by translation readers in two rounds (decision 0079 item 7): the en pairs of keys changed in (B) and (C) and the ru→en pair of now_idea_s; marks only for the offering of orders, a price or a term. Hard rules: edit ONLY the REQ-113 block of docs/requirements.yaml; do not weaken any criterion or mutant, and every exact-value table, mutant and guard row that quotes an old value is updated to the new value; keep the numbers of criteria; keep the public word-list facts true (the new sentences contain no banned word: check «срок», «день», «минут», «цена», «бесплатно», «гарантия», «100 %» and the lists Г, Б, В, П, Ц, С of app/scripts, and at most 18 words per phrase); the key count stays 179 (no key is added or removed). Do NOT touch REQ-111, REQ-112 or any other block; do not edit decisions or other files.
